title: Sources: prices for Nvidia's AI chips on China's black market have more than doubled amid a US export crackdown; its flagship DGX B300 server has risen to $1.1M (Eleanor Olcott/Financial Times)
summary: Eleanor Olcott / Financial Times: Sources: prices for Nvidia's AI chips on China's black market have more than doubled amid a US export crackdown; its flagship DGX B300 server has risen to $1.1M — US crackdown on illicit exports has made it riskier, harder and more expensive to buy tech giant's processors
